searches.reason: Move from input sensitivity to locating which NextItNet residual blocks and temporal lags transmit recent versus older context. Seek practical activation-patching controls that distinguish computational influence from perturbation artifacts, using fixed candidates and final-nonpadding readout. This could connect observed failures to specific backbone components without claiming to identify user intent or training causality.

searches.reason: Translate qualitative complaints into auditable recommendation-level evidence: recent-history connections, explicit specification conflicts, possible duplication, and unidentified items. Seek grounded annotation protocols with supporting title/description spans, abstention, blinded paired judgments and agreement checks. Keep missing compatibility or ownership evidence separate from confirmed mismatches; fit no auxiliary predictor or score fusion.

searches.reason: Establish whether probes reliably detect known implementation failures and add useful information beyond margins and candidate ranks. Seek bounded mutation tests for padding, endpoint selection, causality and temporal pathways, with negative controls and sensitivity/specificity measurements. Any later claim that diagnostics guide improvements should use prespecified single-model NextItNet interventions and unchanged host validation, preserving supplied splits and one checkpoint per category.
